subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept this private matrix-js-sdk `cryptoBackend.preprocessToDeviceMessages` wrapper for malformed Matrix SAS accept events after live proof is added?
rationale: The code path is security-boundary-adjacent and depends on an intended-private dependency field, so green CI cannot decide whether the compatibility tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Require Proof Then Accept Hook
options.body: Ask for redacted live Element/Synapse verification proof first, then merge if the private hook remains the preferred bounded workaround.

options.title: Accept With Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override live proof and own the private SDK hook risk if they have equivalent private validation.

options.title: Pause For Upstream Fix
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to patch Matrix SDK preprocessing internals.

recommendation.title: Require Proof Then Accept Hook
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Element/Synapse verification proof first, then merge if the private hook remains the preferred bounded workaround.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal for Matrix E2EE and verification setup in the touched code path.
